author: Jonathan Yantis
scope: Selected public summaries from fixed concurrent post-fix hardware observations; raw native logs remain private.

comparison_window.selection: Fixed concurrent 180 s window, RC trial +60 s through +240 s; selected by duration and common host monotonic time, not error magnitude. All rows within window retained.

common_configuration.fine_feed: Unqualified causal SOF/Mach plus immutable corrected source map and retained UTC offset
common_configuration.bus_condition: SHARED / NOT CLEAN; other USB devices and concurrent timing work present
common_configuration.clean_bus_test: PENDING physical isolated-controller setup and matched repeat

DC.transport: local GNSS -> USB -> macOS; zero BLE hops

definitions.RX_RMS: Causal corrected-source prediction errors using only the previous 64–1024 accepted observations. Replay all preceding captured observations before scoring errors in the common window. Retain mean/transients; no retrospective detrending; UTC offset excluded.
definitions.delivered_minus_fine: Delivered chrony UTC minus its unqualified fine input source at the exact same host wall/Mach instant; each comparison shares its source, not independent UTC truth.
definitions.chrony_estimator_RMS: Median of the latest synchronized tracking readout at each native status point in the window, including cached readouts; not a median of query-event timestamps. Distinct from RX RMS and delivered-minus-fine.
definitions.availability: All native 1 Hz status observations in the same fixed window. Point samples, not continuous coverage. Delivered-status and exact same-instant comparison counts can differ because they use separately sampled brackets.
definitions.p99: Nearest rank ceil(.99*n) over absolute differences.

analysis.validation: Full first 300 s replay agrees exactly with shipping precision-replay: 8,364 predictions and 188.21564971520098 ns RMS. Both common-window denominators balance.

limitations: Shared USB bus; clean-bus validation is pending. Direct-port frame identity does not establish a quiet or isolated controller.
Same measurement methods/configuration/window, separate physical GNSS source chains. No controlled effect or superiority claim.
Window is after acquisition; no complete-trial, startup or continuous-delivery qualification. All withheld rows and hardware rejects within window remain in counts.
RC first post-readback capture had delayed BLE acquisition and no usable UTC for 60 s. It is retained separately from the settled comparison; acquisition behavior remains under investigation.
PPS-to-UTC association, host/PHY bias and independent UTC accuracy remain unqualified.
The requested two-hour trials were still in progress when this fixed window was selected.
